basis: Melanin synthesis disorder defining skin/hair hypopigmentation and ocular developmental defects with visual impairment.
Benign cutaneous melanocytic nevus composed of spindle-shaped melanocytes.
Defines peptic ulceration, hiatus hernia and cutaneous pigmentary lesions; myopia in 80-99%. Diabetes is separately diagnosed and excluded.
Soft-tissue parachordoma arising in the chest wall; no evidence of pulmonary involvement.
Hereditary annular erythematous skin disorder; no established systemic involvement or autoimmune mechanism.
Defines skeletal growth restriction, delayed skeletal maturation and limb asymmetry. Crowded teeth alone do not establish functional damage; neurologic and hypoglycemic features are under 30%.
Immune small-vessel cutaneous vasculitis; renal disease in 30-79%. Arthritis and ocular inflammation also occur in 30-79%, omitted by cap; destructive lung disease is less frequent.
Defined by congenital emphysematous/interstitial lung disease; FLNA associations alone do not establish other organ involvement.
Myopia-associated degeneration of the retinal macula; neurological ancestry does not establish separate neurologic disease.
Ascaridia intestinal nematode infection, principally described in fowl; definition does not support extrapolating Ascaris pulmonary migration.
Terminal complement immunodeficiency; recurrent Neisserial infections are separate infectious episodes, without a defining damaged organ.
Hereditary nonpolyposis colorectal cancer syndrome; extracolonic cancers are separately diagnosed outcomes and do not establish involved organs.
Congenital stationary retinal dysfunction causing night blindness; no separate neurologic involvement established.
Cobalamin metabolism defect with defining anemia and neurodevelopmental impairment; retinal/optic damage in 30-79%. Glomerulopathy and oral inflammation omitted by cap.
Clonal myeloid blast malignancy of marrow and blood; other tissue infiltration is uncommon, and infections are secondary complications.
Multiple or disseminated melanoma, usually of cutaneous origin. Site is unspecified; meningeal melanomatosis is a subtype, not universal neurologic involvement.
Defines neurodevelopmental impairment, persistent fetal hemoglobin and lymphoid hyperplasia, localized to adenoids in 12/12. Cardiac defects are not consistently common.
Compression damages the optic nerve or chiasm and causes visual loss; optic nerve disease belongs to the ocular axis.
Splitting of retinal layers, a localized retinal disorder.
Inborn gluconeogenesis defect causing hypoglycemia. Hepatic failure/steatosis frequencies are unspecified; renal steatosis alone does not establish impaired function.
Immune-mediated proliferative glomerular inflammation following streptococcal infection; no common directly damaged extra-renal organ.
Placental trophoblastic disease of pregnancy, outside the axes. Hyperthyroidism is an uncommon complication; vomiting does not establish gastrointestinal damage.
Substance-related psychiatric umbrella; specific neurologic or hepatic disorders are separately diagnosed and are not shared across most patients.
Malignant neoplasm occupying the choroid, ciliary body or iris; no other organ involvement is intrinsic to this umbrella.
Systemic opportunistic fungal infection; affected anatomical organs vary across subtypes, with no additional organ established in most patients.
